hooks.command: c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$c" | grep -qE '(^|[;&|]+[[:space:]]*)git commit([[:space:]]|$)'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"Project rule: get your confirmation after you have reviewed the change before committing locally."}}'; fi

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.md) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"Project rule: get your confirmation after you have reviewed the change before updating any markdown file (including memory files)."}}';; esac
